headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: NOR (5)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Canadian Grand Prix from pole position, 9.6s ahead of Fernando Alonso, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Lance Stroll made the biggest climb, from P16 to P9.
Nico Hulkenberg had a day to forget, dropping from P5 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised NOR (5 second time penalty).
There were 33 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 69 points over Sergio Perez.
